user.title: Add a PTLevel receiver
user.description: Enter the address of a PTLevel WiFi receiver on your network. Receivers do not announce themselves, so give each one a DHCP reservation first.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the receiver.

reconfigure.title: Change the receiver's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the receiver's new address. It must be the same receiver; to add a different one, add a new entry instead.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the receiver.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a PTLevel receiver at that address.
error.invalid_host: Enter just a hostname or IP address, without http://, a port or a path.
error.unsupported_receiver: Something answered at that address, but not a supported PTLevel receiver. Only Version 1 receivers (firmware 2xx, no button on the front) are supported so far.

abort.wrong_device: That address answers as a different receiver. To add it, add a new entry instead.

init.title: Tank level
init.description: The water column is measured from the chamber's air pocket, a few inches above the tank floor. Calibrate against a measured depth to get the tank's water depth, then set the full depth to get a percentage.

calibrate.title: Calibrate from a measured depth
calibrate.description: The latest report, seen {reported}, shows {water_column} in of water above the chamber. Measure the water from the tank floor to the surface before the transmitter reports again, and enter it here. The difference becomes the depth offset.

data_description.measured_depth: Inches of water from the tank floor to the surface.

tank.title: Tank settings
tank.description: Water depth is the water column plus the depth offset. Percent full is the water depth as a share of the full depth. Leave the full depth empty for no percentage.

data_description.depth_offset: Inches to add to the water column to get the water depth, about the height of the chamber's air pocket above the floor. Calibrating sets it for you.
data_description.full_depth: Water depth, in inches, that counts as 100%. Use the level where the fill pump stops, or the overflow if nothing stops the fill.

error.implausible_depth: That measurement is too far from the reading to be right. Check the measurement, and that the transmitter has reported since the chamber went in.

abort.no_reading: There is no water column to calibrate against yet. Wait for the transmitter to report, or press its button, then try again.
abort.unverified_scale: This transmitter's hardware has no verified pressure scale, so there is no water column to calibrate against. Water depth and percent full need transmitter hardware 16.
